Sandbox_AmmoMaking_SpentCaseRecovery: Spent cases found, per hundred rounds fired (experimental)
Sandbox_AmmoMaking_SpentCaseRecovery_too: EXPERIMENTAL, single player only. How many of a hundred fired rounds leave a spent case that can be picked up. A spent case is scrapped at a quarter of its brass, or resized at its die set, two into one usable case. 0 leaves none.
